prompt: Get production of portal-agent/ ready: attach it to the Gateway `public-gw` in the namespace `gateways` with the hostname `agents.acme.com`, with its TLS certificate from cert-manager's ClusterIssuer `letsencrypt-prod`. Prove that a prod deploy would render, without deploying anything.

checks.expr: get(data, 'gateway.parentRef.name') == 'public-gw' and get(data, 'gateway.parentRef.namespace') == 'gateways' and get(data, 'gateway.hostname') == 'agents.acme.com' and get(data, 'tls.certManager.enabled') is True and get(data, 'tls.certManager.issuerRef.name') == 'letsencrypt-prod' and get(data, 'tls.certManager.issuerRef.kind', 'ClusterIssuer') == 'ClusterIssuer'

checks.why: values.yaml is shared by every environment; other environments must not change

reference: In values-prod.yaml: `gateway.hostname: agents.acme.com`, `gateway.parentRef: {name: public-gw, namespace: gateways}`, `tls.certManager: {enabled: true, issuerRef: {name: letsencrypt-prod, kind: ClusterIssuer}}`; then `graph-agents-cli deploy --env prod --dry-run` renders the HTTPRoute and the Certificate (it reads .env.prod).
